hook.text: A company with a 200-page ethics manual commits massive fraud. The manual was for show.

buildup.text: Corporate compliance programs are designed to prevent fraud through policies, training, and oversight.

discovery.text: Effective programs need more than documents — they need a culture where reporting fraud is safe.

twist.text: Enron had one of the most detailed ethics codes in corporate America. It meant nothing in practice.

climax.text: Companies with genuine ethics cultures experience 50% fewer fraud incidents than those without.

punchline.text: Ethics is a culture, not a binder on a shelf.

quiz.question: What makes an ethics program actually effective?
options: Creating a culture where reporting fraud is safe
Requiring all employees to sign a form
